og.og:title: MENÚ ROSANTA · ANTIGUA GUATEMALA
og.og:description:
Cocina de temporada en el corazón de Antigua Guatemala. Nuestro menú cambia con lo que da el jardín y con lo que traen los productores cercanos, así que siempre hay algo nuevo que probar. Este es el menú completo, con precios actuales.
Incluye entradas, opciones saludables, hamburguesas, platos fuertes, acompañamientos, café y bebidas de la casa, nuestra carta de cocteles y la carta de vinos. Si prefieres verlo en la mesa, el mismo menú está impreso en el restaurante.

jsonld.name: Rosanta
jsonld.description: Garden restaurant in Antigua Guatemala. Farm to table cuisine with seasonal, local ingredients. Creative cocktails and sustainable gastronomy.

hasMenuSection.name: TO START · Flavorful beginnings
hasMenuSection.description: Starters made to welcome you to the table with intention and care. Prepared with fresh ingredients that bring out the richness of the season and the land.

hasMenuItem.name: Rosanta Salad
hasMenuItem.description: Mixed greens, roasted tomatoes, orange, creamy avocado, peach macerated with a touch of heat, house pickles, and a strawberry and spearmint vinaigrette. Suggested pairing: El Fufurufo · Gin, cucumber cordial, simple syrup, lime.

hasMenuItem.name: Grilled Cauliflower with Romesco
hasMenuItem.description: Grilled cauliflower, golden outside and tender inside, over a romesco sauce of roasted pepper and almond, finished with herbs from the garden.

hasMenuItem.name: Broccoli with Nduja
hasMenuItem.description: Roasted broccoli with nduja from Sal Charcutería, a Calabrian cured sausage made here in Guatemala. Soft, spreadable and full of character. Created with Sal Charcutería · Ordering it supports Niños de Guatemala and the schooling of children in the area. Learn about the project at ninosdeguatemala.org

hasMenuItem.name: Baked Cheese
hasMenuItem.description: Oven-baked cheese crusted in pepitoria, with strawberries macerated in red wine, a tomato compote and caramelized onions, served with house-made toast with garden herbs. Suggested pairing: Beetroot Negroni · Gin, clarified beet shrub, finished with Campari. Cheese from a cooperative of small producers in Quetzaltenango.

hasMenuItem.name: Grilled Octopus
hasMenuItem.description: Pacific octopus from the grill, with paprika potatoes, a smooth pea purée, spearmint mayonnaise, orange supremes and roasted tomatoes. Suggested pairing: Mezcal a la Piña · Espadín mezcal, pineapple jam smoked with rosemary and scented with herbs.

hasMenuItem.name: Charcuterie and Cheese Board
hasMenuItem.description: Aged cheeses and cured meats to share, served with house pickles and fresh fruit. Suggested pairing: To enjoy in the garden, a Rosé Pasión Spritz.

hasMenuSection.name: HEALTHY OPTIONS · Nourishing harvests
hasMenuSection.description: Cooking consciously also means nourishing with intention. Made with fresh ingredients, seasonal vegetables and house dressings. Every combination is meant to take care of you and reconnect you with natural flavors. All dishes can be customized with tofu, tuna or grilled chicken as your protein.

hasMenuItem.name: Mushroom Tartare
hasMenuItem.description: A fusion of fresh mushrooms, pickled radish, peach macerated in Irish whiskey with a touch of heat and grilled, served with peanut butter and crisp malanga chips. Vegan dish, no protein customization. Suggested pairing: La Lotería · Espadín mezcal, radish cordial, lime, syrup. Wild mushrooms and house pickles.

hasMenuItem.name: Grilled Bok Choy
hasMenuItem.description: Grilled bok choy over a bed of house-made dill yogurt, with roasted tomatoes and basil oil. House-made dill yogurt.

hasMenuItem.name: Mediterranean Bowl
hasMenuItem.description: A base of lettuce or couscous with a colorful mix of fresh vegetables, olives, chickpeas, pumpkin seed and avocado, brought together with a roasted red pepper dressing and a boiled egg on top.

hasMenuItem.name: Fermented Vegetables
hasMenuItem.description: A bowl of naturally slow-fermented vegetables in a Thai peanut sauce with a touch of honey. Suggested pairing: Rose Collins · Red berry gin, lime juice, syrup.

hasMenuSection.name: BURGERS · From the garden and the grill
hasMenuSection.description: Eating well is simple when you choose fresh ingredients and techniques that respect the product. These combinations are meant to be enjoyed simply, with flavor and care. Every burger comes on a turmeric brioche bun with melted mozzarella, pickles and avocado and celery mayonnaise. Served with crispy potato and sweet potato fries.

hasMenuItem.name: Roasted Portobello
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy portobello mushroom roasted with garden herb butter. Suggested pairing: La Feria · Espadín mezcal, spiced pineapple jam and wine.

hasMenuItem.name: Sliced Tenderloin
hasMenuItem.description: With tender grilled spring onions and a fresh gremolata of garden herbs. Suggested pairing: El Colonial · Colonial Antigüeño rum, spiced syrup with hibiscus. Local cut, gremolata chopped to order.

hasMenuSection.name: SOMETHING STRONGER · Cooking with roots and fire
hasMenuSection.description: Main courses meant to honor what the land gives. Each preparation combines techniques that respect the ingredient, slow cooking when it is needed, and a balance between intensity and freshness. Here we celebrate local product, recipes with history and flavor that is properly worked.

hasMenuItem.name: House Pasta
hasMenuItem.description: House-made fettuccine in red sauce with confit tomatoes, garlic, onion, mushrooms and a touch of wine.

hasMenuItem.name: Creamy Rice
hasMenuItem.description: Rice cooked slowly until creamy, with whatever the sea and the garden gave this week.

hasMenuItem.name: Chicken in Tamarind Sauce
hasMenuItem.description: Chicken breast in a tamarind and red pepper sauce with a touch of ginger, flambéed in rum. Carrot cream, almond mushrooms and roasted beets. Citrusy, smoky and full of texture.

hasMenuItem.name: Pork Ribs
hasMenuItem.description: Oven-baked ribs in a delicious coffee and cardamom rub, with roasted onions, creamy yuca purée and pickled broccoli. Suggested pairing: La Chef · Fat-washed American whiskey.

hasMenuItem.name: Rosanta Tenderloin
hasMenuItem.description: Tenderloin medallion cooked to your liking, with a spinach and rosemary purée over black garlic sauce, finished with fermented carrots. Suggested pairing: Red Pepper.

hasMenuItem.name: Brisket in Bordelaise Sauce
hasMenuItem.description: With roasted plantain purée and confit garlic. Yuca terrine, grapes macerated in rosé vermouth and bok choy leaves.

hasMenuItem.name: Braised Oxtail
hasMenuItem.description: Oxtail in a traditional stew, with roasted cauliflower purée, demi-glace and macerated radish.

hasMenuItem.name: Catch of the Day
hasMenuItem.description: The day's catch, served with a white wine sauce scented with sage, sweet potato purée and roasted carrots, tender green beans and grilled bok choy. Gentle, herbal preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: Oven-Baked Shrimp
hasMenuItem.description: Shrimp baked with garden herbs, with cherry tomatoes, olive oil, sesame oil, garlic and onion. Simple, aromatic and full of freshness.

hasMenuItem.name: Surf & Turf
hasMenuItem.description: Grilled tenderloin, garlic shrimp, grilled spring onions, fresh salad and crispy fries.

hasMenuItem.name: Green beans in sesame oil and garlic

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · House refreshments
hasMenuSection.description: Made here with real fruit and herbs cut in the garden. Our own recipes, prepared fresh every day.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Coffee from Guatemala
hasMenuSection.description: Coffee grown in Guatemala, prepared simply so the origin comes through. To open the morning or to close the table.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Garden herb teas
hasMenuSection.description: Infusions made with herbs and spices grown steps from your table, served by the half litre to share.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Artisan tea infusions
hasMenuSection.description: Infusions made with herbs and spices grown steps from your table, served by the half litre to share.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Beers
hasMenuSection.description: Guatemalan beers, cold and straightforward, for a long afternoon in the garden.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Craft beers
hasMenuSection.description: Craft beers from Antigua Guatemala, made by small local breweries.

hasMenuSection.name: DRINKS · Digestifs
hasMenuSection.description: To close the table without rushing. Classic digestifs and coffee-based drinks to stretch the conversation.

hasMenuSection.name: COCKTAILS · The Essentials
hasMenuSection.description: Our bar reflects the same philosophy of sustainability. We work with macerations, natural syrups, artisan teas and fresh product. Ask about our seasonal creations.

hasMenuItem.name: Mezcal with Pineapple
hasMenuItem.description: Espadín mezcal, smoked pineapple jam with rosemary and garden herbs, simple syrup, lime juice and a hibiscus salt rim. Suggested pairing: Grilled Octopus.

hasMenuItem.name: El Fufurufo
hasMenuItem.description: Gin, cucumber cordial with Samat, simple syrup, lime juice and a touch of rosemary-infused kombucha. Suggested pairing: Rosanta Salad.

hasMenuItem.name: Red Pepper
hasMenuItem.description: Colonial Antigüeño rum infused with roasted red bell peppers, tobacco bitters, a touch of syrup, smoked with vanilla tobacco. Suggested pairing: Rosanta Tenderloin.

hasMenuItem.name: Beetroot Negroni
hasMenuItem.description: Gin, beetroot shrub, finished with Campari. Suggested pairing: Baked Cheese.

hasMenuItem.name: El Colonial
hasMenuItem.description: Colonial Antigüeño rum, spiced hibiscus syrup, mandarin juice, finished with house soda. Suggested pairing: Sliced Tenderloin Burger.

hasMenuSection.name: COCKTAILS · Seasonal Harvest
hasMenuSection.description: These change with what the garden gives. Whatever is ripe that week decides what goes in the glass.

hasMenuItem.name: El Canche
hasMenuItem.description: Gin, Campari, grapefruit juice, lavender, finished with soda. Suggested pairing: Oven-Baked Shrimp.

hasMenuItem.name: La Lotería
hasMenuItem.description: Gin, radish cordial, lime juice, simple syrup and roasted, smoked and spiced pineapple juice. Suggested pairing: Mushroom Tartare.

hasMenuItem.name: La Chef
hasMenuItem.description: American whiskey fat-washed with pork rib flavor extraction, cucumber slices, lavender syrup and mandarin juice. Suggested pairing: Pork Ribs.

hasMenuItem.name: La Feria
hasMenuItem.description: Espadín mezcal, pineapple jam with spices and wine, lime juice, simple syrup, finished with a mint sugar rim. Suggested pairing: Roasted Portobello Burger.

hasMenuItem.name: Chaitenango

hasMenuItem.name: Boga

MENÚ ROSANTA · ANTIGUA GUATEMALA

Cocina de temporada en el corazón de Antigua Guatemala. Nuestro menú cambia con lo que da el jardín y con lo que traen los productores cercanos, así que siempre hay algo nuevo que probar. Este es el menú completo, con precios actuales. Incluye entradas, opciones saludables, hamburguesas, platos fuertes, acompañamientos, café y bebidas de la casa, nuestra carta de cocteles y la carta de vinos. Si prefieres verlo en la mesa, el mismo menú está impreso en el restaurante.
